 Adani Power shines on signing power supply agreement with Uttarakhand Power Corporation
 News By Tags | 
 #StockMarket 
 #PowerSector 
 #AdaniPowerLtd 
 Adani Power is currently trading at Rs. 204.45, up by 3.05 points or 1.51% from its previous closing of Rs. 201.40 on the BSE.
 The scrip opened at Rs. 206.15 and has touched a high and low of Rs. 206.35 and Rs. 203.65 respectively. So far 22701 shares were traded on the counter.
 The BSE group 'A' stock of face value Rs. 2 has touched a 52 week high of Rs. 254.15 on 29-May-2026 and a 52 week low of Rs. 128.35 on 23-Jan-2026.
 Last one week high and low of the scrip stood at Rs. 206.35 and Rs. 187.50 respectively. The current market cap of the company is Rs. 388393.75 crore.
 The promoters holding in the company stood at 74.96%, while Institutions and Non-Institutions held 15.50% and 9.54% respectively.
 Adani Power has signed a 25-year Power Supply Agreement (PSA) with the Uttarakhand Power Corporation (UPCL) for 1,234 MW ex-bus net supply (1,320 MW installed capacity) of Thermal Power pursuant to the company being declared as the successful bidder in terms of the tender invited and issued by UPCL.
 Adani Power is engaged in the business of generation, accumulation, distribution and supply of power and to generally deal in electricity and to explore, develop, generate, accumulate, supply and distribute or to deal in other forms of energy from any source whatsoever.
